subject: Privilege ownership mapping + SCIM sample request from Acme Health
messages:
From: Trevor Simmons <trevor@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: prodsec@acmehealth.com
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: privilege ownership mapping + SCIM sample for SIG

Hi Ben,

We're working through the SIG questionnaire and need a couple of artifacts to close out the Access Control section for our upcoming audit. Can you provide the following by EOD next Wednesday (6/18)?

- Privilege ownership mapping (who owns each role/group + justification)
- A small SCIM export sample (redacted) showing user -> groups + attributes used for role assignment
- Example SAML assertion with the attributes you send to customers (anonymized)

Ideally we get a spreadsheet for the mapping and a CSV for the SCIM extract. If you have a compiled zip with evidence that's fine too.

Thanks,
Trevor
Trevor Simmons
Director, Product Security
Acme Health

[attachment: request-SIG-Acme-2025.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: privilege ownership mapping + SCIM sample for SIG

Laura / Marissa — looping you both in, Acme needs a scoped evidence set for the SIG access control questions. Ask from Trevor below. Can we commit to EOD Wed (6/18)?

Proposed split: 
- Laura: produce the privilege ownership mapping (spreadsheet) and list of role definitions + justification statements.
- Marissa: pull a redacted SCIM export (CSV) and an example SAML assertion we can anonymize.

Notes: keep PII redacted, include a short note on our least-privilege design decisions and RBAC enforcement points (where roles are enforced: console, API tokens, service accounts). I'll assemble and send to Trevor.

Also attach the SIG guidance they sent earlier.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

[attachment: Acme_SIG_Inquiry_6-12.pdf (pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: privilege ownership mapping + SCIM sample for SIG

Thanks Ben — we can deliver. High-level approach and what I will include in the spreadsheet:

- Tab 1: role_catalog.xlsx — role id, role name, canonical owner (name + team), least-privilege justification (one-sentence), enforcement surface (API/Console/CLI), last_reviewed date
- Tab 2: service_accounts — mapping of service accounts to roles and why (short rationale)
- Tab 3: exception_log — current known exceptions and mitigation steps (if any)

I'll anonymize owner contact values (use team aliases) instead of real email addresses. Expect a draft by Tue EOD; final by Wed morning. Attaching a template and will populate.

Laura Bennett
Director, Identity & Access
Redwood Inference
[attachment: min_priv_mapping.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: privilege ownership mapping + SCIM sample for SIG

Quick update — attached a redacted SCIM export CSV (sample of 30 rows) and an example SAML assertion payload (anonymized attribute names). Key points:

- SCIM export contains: id, userName, displayName, active, emails (redacted), groups (group ids), roles_attribute (our internal role tag)
- We removed any PII and replaced emails with user<N>@example.com; group ids preserved for mapping clarity
- SAML assertion example includes: NameID (pseudonymized), attributes: email (anonymized), groups, role_claim (role ids)
- Note for auditors: SCIM exports are generated from the provisioning service; delta syncs are available on request but we provided a point-in-time sample

Attachments: scim_export_sample.csv; saml_assertion_samples.txt

I'll also include a short readme in the compiled package explaining redaction rules.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Trevor Simmons <trevor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: prodsec@acmehealth.com, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: privilege ownership mapping + SCIM sample for SIG

Trevor — attaching the compiled evidence package per your request. Summary of what's included:

- min_priv_mapping.xlsx — role catalog (role ids, owners (team-level), one-line justifications, enforcement surface)
- scim_export_sample.csv — 30-row redacted SCIM export (user -> groups & role attribute)
- saml_assertion_samples.txt — anonymized SAML assertion examples and an explanation of which attributes we supply
- readme.txt — redaction rules and how to interpret the files; contact points for follow-ups

Drive link (view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-priv-mapping
HubSpot: HS-392182 (linked to Acme Health)

Best,
